name: @papercusp/hash-chain
description: Tamper-evident append-only hash chains: per-stream links where each entry carries the hash of the previous one, a verifier that recomputes the chain and reports the FIRST break (edited, deleted, inserted, reordered or truncated entries), and a stable, strictly-canonical JSONL export that round-trips byte-for-byte. Pure, zero-dependency beyond node:crypto, storage-agnostic — the caller supplies the rows and decides where links live.
